name: Pai Gow Poker
description: Pai Gow Poker is a popular casino game that combines elements of the traditional Chinese game Pai Gow with American poker. Players are dealt seven cards and must divide them into a five-card high hand and a two-card low hand. The goal is to beat both of the dealer's corresponding hands, requiring strategic balancing of card strength between the two partitions.

content.text: Pai Gow Poker is a popular casino game that combines elements of the traditional Chinese game Pai Gow with American poker. Players are dealt seven cards and must divide them into a five-card high hand and a two-card low hand. The goal is to beat both of the dealer's corresponding hands, requiring strategic balancing of card strength between the two partitions.
Conceptualized in 1985 by Sam Torosian at the Bell Card Club in Los Angeles, California.
Typically played with six players and a dealer who acts as the banker.
Standard pack including one Joker. The Joker is semi-wild, completing straights and flushes or acting as an Ace.
Standard poker cards, casino chips, and sometimes dice to determine starting positions.
Seven face-down piles of seven cards are dealt; four cards remain unused.

items.text: Face-Up Pai Gow: Dealer reveals their hand first; commission is removed, but dealer Ace-high pushes all.
Fortune Side Bet: Optional bet on the quality of the overall seven-card hand ranking.
Progressive Pai Gow: Jackpot side bet awarded for rare high-ranking hands like a seven-card straight flush.
